title: Steam Machine launches today
summary: Valve's Steam Machine initiative, a Linux-based living room gaming console designed to bring PC gaming to the TV, officially launches to allow users to play Steam games in a console-like experience using SteamOS.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between traditional PC gaming and living room console gaming experience.
why_valuable: Offered an open-source, console-style alternative to traditional gaming consoles while maintaining PC gaming flexibility and the Steam ecosystem.
